name: Classic Anda Paratha Roll
description: Crisp flaky layered paratha rolled with seasoned farm egg, sliced red onions, and tangy mint chutney.

name: Halwa Puri Morning Thali
description: Two hot crispy puris served with spiced chana tarkari, sweet semolina halwa, and mixed pickle.

name: Cheese Omelette with Toasted Bread
description: Two-egg fluffy cheese omelette with diced bell peppers and green chillies, served with two buttered bread slices.

name: Special Canteen Chicken Biryani
description: Aromatic basmati rice cooked with marinated chicken piece, traditional spices, fresh mint, and served with raita.

name: Homestyle Daal Chawal Plate
description: Comforting yellow lentil tadka served over fragrant steamed white rice, salad crunch, and spicy mango pickle.

name: Student Mini Chicken Karahi
description: Sizzling wok-cooked chicken in rich tomato, ginger, and green chilli gravy, served with two hot tandoori rotis.

name: Crispy Canteen Zinger Burger
description: Golden fried crispy battered chicken thigh fillet with fresh iceberg lettuce, garlic mayo, and toasted sesame bun.

name: Grilled Chicken Club Sandwich
description: Triple-layer toasted sandwich stuffed with seasoned shredded chicken, fried egg, cheese slice, and fries.

name: Cheesy Loaded Masala Fries
description: Crisp potato fries dusted in chaat masala, smothered in warm cheddar cheese sauce, jalapenos, and chipotle dip.

name: Special Samosa Chaat Bowl
description: Two crushed potato-pea samosas topped with warm spiced chickpeas, sweetened yogurt, tamarind chutney, and sev.

name: Karachi Shami Egg Bun Kabab
description: Pan-fried dal-beef shami patty with whipped egg coating, onion rings, and spicy green chutney in a toasted bun.

name: Golden Chicken Puff Patty
description: Buttery bakery puff pastry packed with creamy minced chicken filling, served warm with chili garlic sauce.

name: Dhaba Cardamom Karak Chai
description: Slow-brewed strong black tea simmered with fresh milk and fragrant green cardamom pods. The ultimate study fuel.

name: Chilled Mint Margarita Lemonade
description: Ice-blended sparkling drink with fresh garden mint leaves, freshly squeezed lemons, black salt, and sprite.

name: Campus Iced Spanish Latte
description: Double shot of rich espresso poured over chilled sweetened condensed milk and fresh dairy milk on the rocks.
